module_summary: Gray-code clock-domain-crossing FIFO split into source and destination halves that exchange the storage array and gray-coded write/read pointers across asynchronous clock domains.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain payload written into the FIFO storage.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source-side valid requesting a FIFO write.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source-side ready, low when FIFO full.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Destination-domain payload read from the FIFO.

anchors.name: async_data
anchors.why: FIFO storage array written by source, read asynchronously by destination.

anchors.name: async_wptr
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer crossing to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer crossing back to source domain.

groups.name: src_half
groups.description: Source-domain write side holding storage and gray write pointer.

groups.name: dst_half
groups.description: Destination-domain read side syncing write pointer and producing output stream.

groups.name: async_fifo_storage
groups.description: Shared storage array crossing the clock domain boundary.
